question: What museum exist within a 50 kilometers distance along the way to Downtown Canton Arts District, Canton, OH from Blue Hen Falls Trailhead, Brecksville, OH?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.572582 41.256432)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.376984 40.797328)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'museum'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.572582 41.256432)',4326)::geography, 50000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.572582 41.256432)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

answers.poi_name: Watkins Academy Museum of the Cultural Arts

[3].display_name: Blue Hen Falls Trailhead, Brecksville, OH

[4].display_name: Downtown Canton Arts District, Canton, OH
